title: ChatGPT Power Prompts: 50 Proven Templates for Better Results Instantly
author: Malaclyde
excerpt: 50 proven prompt templates across 5 categories. Copy, paste, customize — get better results from ChatGPT instantly.
content:
Getting great results from ChatGPT isn't about the model — it's about the prompt. The right prompt structure can mean the difference between generic fluff and actionable, high-quality output.

ChatGPT Power Prompts gives you 50 tested templates across 5 categories that you can copy, paste, and customize immediately.

What's Inside

  • Content Creation (10 prompts) — Blog posts, social media, email newsletters, video scripts
  • Business Operations (10 prompts) — Process documentation, SOPs, meeting agendas, project plans
  • Marketing (10 prompts) — Ad copy, landing pages, customer personas, competitor analysis
  • Productivity (10 prompts) — Task prioritization, time blocking, decision frameworks
  • Personal Development (10 prompts) — Goal setting, journaling, skill development plans

Get the Prompts →
